question: To whom may this secret teaching be appropriately revealed?
premises: The teaching is restricted from the unworthy
It may be given to a devotee free from sin
It may be given to a great-souled practitioner
inference: The secret teaching should be revealed only to a sinless, great-souled devotee and practitioner
plain_english: It may be given to a devotee free from sin, to a practitioner, to the great-souled one.
